title: Guilds
summary: A mobile gaming crypto wallet built with a small founding team, across React Native, a React Native Web companion app and a Python/FastAPI backend.
challenge: As one of a small founding team, Guilds needed a mobile gaming crypto wallet delivered across native mobile and a companion web app from a single source of truth, backed by reliable APIs and data, while working closely with the CTO, backend engineer and designer to keep product and engineering decisions aligned.
approach: Designed a reusable React Native component library shared between the mobile app and a React Native Web companion build, styled with Styled Components for consistent theming across platforms. Developed and updated Python/FastAPI REST services for CRUD workflows and third-party integrations, and worked directly with PostgreSQL using SQL and pgAdmin to validate application state and troubleshoot API and data issues across the mobile clients and backend.
outcome: Delivered features across mobile, web and backend from early development through hands-on client testing and the product's first launch.
